certification workflow reads this file, boots that exact pair, and — on
green merge — appends a ledger tag. A maintenance branch (release/lts-*)
carries its own frozen copy of this file and its era-appropriate fixture.
digest is the artifact content address that was booted. Both components now
publish digest-addressed images, so digest is never null on this line; if one
ever is, the certification workflow skips the boot as an honest no-op rather
